package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type ProvisionInput struct {
	StudentID   string
	ContextType domain.LearningContextType
	ContextID   string
}

// Provision ensures one Dialog-owned conversation for the authenticated
// student, their canonical PersonalTeacher, and the requested product context.
type Provision struct {
	Teachers TeacherEnsurer
	Dialogs  repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner
}

func (uc Provision) Execute(ctx context.Context, input ProvisionInput) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	if input.StudentID == "" || uc.Teachers == nil || uc.Dialogs == nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, errors.New("invalid provision teacher dialog request")
	}
	teacher, err := uc.Teachers.Execute(ctx, input.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := uc.Dialogs.EnsureTeacherDialog(
		ctx, input.StudentID, teacher.ID, input.ContextType, input.ContextID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	if binding.StudentID != input.StudentID || binding.PersonalTeacherID != teacher.ID ||
		binding.ContextType != input.ContextType || binding.ContextID != input.ContextID {
		return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable
	}
	return binding, nil
}
